```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```
## Upload expression df 
```{r}
expression_df <- read.csv2("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/04_output/expression_matrix_output/expr_matrix_174_accessions_genes_and_tes_atleast10read_total_in5percentsamples.csv")
expression_df$TE <- expression_df$X
rownames(expression_df) <- expression_df$TE
```
## Select only controls 
```{r}
cn <- colnames(expression_df)
ctrl_pat <- "F1_ddm1_6909|F1_ddm1_6909|ddm1_ct|ct_col"
is_ctrl <- grepl(ctrl_pat, cn)
controls <- expression_df[,is_ctrl]
```

##Make a virtual F1 for each control
```{r}
# Assuming your data frame is called 'matrix'
# Extract plate information from column names

controls$TE <- rownames(controls)
expression_df<-controls
# Check the pivot operation first
long_data_basic <- expression_df %>%
  mutate(gene_id = row_number()) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(TE, gene_id),
    names_to = "sample_id",
    values_to = "expression_value"
  )


## Check presense of NA 
print("After pivot - check for NA sample_ids:")
sum(is.na(long_data_basic$sample_id))

print("Sample of basic long data:")
head(long_data_basic)

# Check empty columns 
colnames(expression_df)[grepl("^$|^\\s*$", colnames(expression_df))]  

## extract info about genotype
# Apply mutations step by step to see where NAs are introduced
long_data_step1 <- long_data_basic %>%
  mutate(
    genotype = case_when(
      grepl("F1_Col", sample_id) ~ "Col",
      grepl("F1_ddm1", sample_id) ~ "F1_ddm1",
      grepl("ct_col", sample_id) ~ "ct_col",
      grepl("ddm1_ct", sample_id) ~ "ddm1_ct",
      sample_id == "TE" ~ "TE",
      TRUE ~ "other"
    )
  )

print("After genotype mutation - any new NAs?")
sum(is.na(long_data_step1$sample_id))

# Check if  regex patterns are working
print("Sample genotype assignments:")
table(long_data_step1$genotype, useNA = "always")

## Get accession
long_data_step1$accession <- str_extract(long_data_step1$sample_id, "(?:[^_]+_){2}([^_]+)")
long_data_step1$accession <- gsub("F1_ddm1_", "", long_data_step1$accession)
long_data_step1$accession <- gsub("ct_col_", "", long_data_step1$accession)
long_data_step1$accession <- gsub("F1_Col_","", long_data_step1$accession)
long_data_step1$accession <- gsub("ddm1_ct_","", long_data_step1$accession)

## Get plate 
# Extract the plate number from the sample_id
long_data_step1$plate <- ifelse(
  grepl("^ct_ddm1_6909_s_6909_", long_data_step1$sample_id), # Check if it matches the specific pattern
  sub("^ct_ddm1_6909_s_6909_[1-9]_([^_]*)_.*", "\\1", long_data_step1$sample_id), # Extract plate for this pattern
  sub("^(?:[^_]*_){4}([^_]*).*", "\\1", long_data_step1$sample_id) # Fallback for other patterns
)
#long_data_step1$plate  <- sub("^(?:[^_]*_){4}", "", long_data_step1$sample_id)
long_data_step1 <- long_data_step1 %>%
  mutate(replicate = str_split_fixed(sample_id, "_", 5)[,4])
```
## Rename plates (because we have 1882 for deep sequencing for majority of the requests, but they came from the different plates)
```{r}
renaming <- read.table("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/04_output/correction_plates_ds.txt", header=T)
## Correct sample ids 
long_data_step1<- long_data_step1 %>% dplyr::mutate(Sample_id = str_extract(sample_id, "[^_]+$"))
#Rename
long_data_step1$plate <- ifelse(long_data_step1$Sample_id %in% renaming$Sample_id,
                                renaming$Request_corrected[match(long_data_step1$Sample_id, renaming$Sample_id)],
                                long_data_step1$plate)
```

## Create virtual F1
```{r}
ct_col <-long_data_step1[long_data_step1$genotype=="ct_col",]
ct_col <- ct_col %>% select(plate,TE,expression_value)
ddm1_ct <-long_data_step1[long_data_step1$genotype=="ddm1_ct",]
ddm1_ct <- ddm1_ct %>% select(plate,TE,expression_value)
F1_ddm1 <-long_data_step1[long_data_step1$genotype=="F1_ddm1",]
F1_ddm1 <- F1_ddm1 %>% select(plate,TE,expression_value)
##Make virtual F1
library(dplyr)

virtual_f1 <- inner_join(ct_col, ddm1_ct,
                         by = c("plate", "TE"),
                         suffix = c("_ct", "_ddm1"))

F1_ddm1_clean    <- distinct(F1_ddm1, plate, TE, .keep_all = TRUE) ## Remove duplicates 


F1_ddm1_clean <- F1_ddm1 %>%
  group_by(plate, TE) %>%
  summarise(expression_value = mean(expression_value, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = 'drop')

## Extract TEs 
tes <- grepl("AT[1-9]TE", virtual_f1$TE)
expression_df_tes <-virtual_f1[tes,]

virtual_f1$virutal_f1 <- (virtual_f1$expression_value_ct+virtual_f1$expression_value_ddm1)/2

ggplot(virtual_f1, aes(expression_value_ddm1,virutal_f1))+geom_point() + facet_wrap(~plate)
                                                                                    
                                                                                    
virtual_f1_2 <- inner_join(virtual_f1, F1_ddm1_clean,
                           by = c("plate", "TE"),
                           suffix = c("", "_real_F1"))



virtual_f1$is_TE <- grepl("AT[1-9]TE", virtual_f1$TE)

library(ggplot2)
# Plot with color based on TE status
ggplot(virtual_f1, aes(expression_value_ddm1, virutal_f1, color = is_TE)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.2, size=2) + 
    facet_wrap(~plate) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "#8DD8FF", "TRUE" = "#A62C2C"),
                       labels = c("FALSE" = "Genes", "TRUE" = "TEs"),
                       name = "Element Type") +
    labs(x = "Expression Value DDM1", 
         y = "Virtual F1",
         title = "Expression Values Colored by TE Status") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 15)

```
## Add read F1 
```{r}
virtual_f1$plate <- as.numeric(virtual_f1$plate)
F1_ddm1_clean$plate <- as.numeric(F1_ddm1_clean$plate)

virtual_f1_with_real_ddm1 <- inner_join(virtual_f1,F1_ddm1_clean,by=c('plate','TE'))
```

##Scatterplot virtual VS real F1 
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

virtual_f1_with_real_ddm1 <- virtual_f1_with_real_ddm1[virtual_f1_with_real_ddm1$is_TE=="TRUE",]
ggplot(virtual_f1_with_real_ddm1, aes(x =  virutal_f1, y = expression_value)) +
  geom_point(size = 1, color = "black", alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red")+
  facet_wrap(~ plate, scales = "free") +
  labs(
    title = "Scatterplot of F1_ddm1 vs Virtual_F1 per Plate",
    x = "Virtual F1",
    y = "F1_ddm1"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```


```{r}
library(dplyr)
# assuming F1_ddm1 and virtual_F1 are log values already


tes <- grepl("AT[1-9]TE", virtual_f1_2$TE)
expression_df_tes <-virtual_f1_2[tes,]

threshold <- 1
merged_plot <- expression_df_tes %>%
  dplyr::mutate(low_ratio = (virutal_f1 - expression_value) > threshold)

ggplot(merged_plot, aes(x = virutal_f1, y =  expression_value, color = low_ratio)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.4, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "purple", `FALSE` = "black")) +
  facet_wrap(~ plate, scales = "free") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15) 
```

write.csv2(hypomethylated_tes, "/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/04_output/expression_matrix_output/hypomethylated_tes_morethan1.csv", quote = F, row.names = F)

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# low_ratio already computed in merged_plot

ggplot(merged_plot, aes(x = F1_ddm1, y = virtual_F1, color = low_ratio)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.4, alpha = 0.7) +

    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.1, size = 4.5, color = "black"
  ) +

```
## Compare virtual F1 to the Pierre 
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

library(dplyr)

# Unique highlighted (plate, TE)
te_highlighted <- merged_plot |>
  filter(low_ratio) |>
  distinct(plate, TE)

# Total number of plates
n_plates <- merged_plot |>
  distinct(plate) |>
  nrow()

# TE IDs highlighted in ALL plates
tes_common_all_plates <- te_highlighted |>
  count(TE, name = "n_plates_highlighted") |>
  filter(n_plates_highlighted == n_plates) |>
  pull(TE)

tes_common_all_plates
```
## Compare to pierre's tes 
```{r}
pierrestes<- read.table("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/11_resources/data_from_pierre/pilot_experiment_upregulated/ddm1xCol_14_vs_virtual_F1_14_downTEs_mean_padj_01.tsv", header=T)
pierrestes <- pierrestes$Geneid

library(VennDiagram)
set_A <-pierrestes
set_B <-tes_common_all_plates

#KANNO_LIMMA=set_C
# Generate the Venn diagram
venn.plot <- venn.diagram(
  x = list(pierre_set=set_A,all_plates = set_B),
  filename = NULL, # Set to NULL to plot directly in R
  fill = c( "green","purple"),
  alpha = 0.5,
  cex = 2,
  cat.cex = 1,
  main = ""
)

# Plot the diagram
grid::grid.draw(venn.plot)


pierrestes_in_intersection <- intersect(pierrestes, tes_common_all_plates)
pierrestes_in_intersection
```
